text:
shadcn-templ

shadcn/ui for templ. A set of beautifully designed components that you can customize, extend, and build on. Start here then make it your own. Open Source. Open Code. Use this to build your own component library. 

shadcn-templ is an unofficial, community-led port of shadcn/ui for Go and templ. We are not affiliated with shadcn, but we did get his blessing before creating this project.

 

 Documentation

Visit to view the documentation.

 Contributing

Please read the contributing guide.
